audit.whatIsWrong: Page called Akali 'he/him/his' in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[0].t, report[8].t and report[11].t, and never named a single Akali ability (packet defect).
audit.why: Akali is female, and the difficulty is specifically about a 350-range Twilight Shroud and an 825 Shuriken Flip against Annie's 625 point-and-click.
audit.corrected: Difficulty restated as: Annie owns levels 1-5 because Akali must enter 625 to do anything; Akali takes over once Shroud is 16s and Perfect Execution is 60s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie/Akali/Akali — all seven rows disagreed.
audit.why: The two layers render the same level-chart row. With 54.51% at 1508 games and Akali's power curve, the content/packet version is the correct one.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides flipped to match; ratings re-scaled 6/6/7/7/7/4/4 and every why re-grounded so the prose agrees with the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text claimed 'she can't hide in Shroud from a pet that tracks her, and your burst still lands through it'. Twilight Shroud makes Akali unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks — Tibbers cannot attack her inside it and your burst does not land through it. spikes[0].text and wants.you[0] also referred to Annie's passive as a shield; Pyromania is the stun, Molten Shield is E.
audit.why: Riot text on W: 'Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. Riot text on Annie's P: 'After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.'
audit.corrected: Rewrote to: the shroud only protects her while she does nothing, since attacking or casting reveals her; Tibbers wins the timing war because 130s R beats her 120s R at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers at all — three generic bullets.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16s at zero cost, Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s for 30 energy, Perfect Execution 120/90/60s, Five Point Strike 1.5s but 110 energy at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Bullets now carry the shroud's 20s rank-1 cooldown, the flip as a single entry/exit button, and the 120s R1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither the execute threshold on Perfect Execution nor the Assassin's Mark auto-reset tell appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags both: R2 executes, and the passive ring means the empowered attack fires when she EXITS the ring, so the wind-up cue is her leaving, not her casting.
audit.corrected: breakdown.feeding and spikes[3].text now say to track the threshold number rather than the health bar; report[8].t names Zhonya's against the R2 landing.

notes: Two real factual errors killed here. (1) spikes[1].text asserted Tibbers tracks Akali through Twilight Shroud and that Annie's burst 'lands through it' — Riot's W text says she is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks', so both halves were false and a player would have died acting on it. (2) spikes[0].text and wants.you[0] called Annie's passive a shield; Pyromania is the stun, Molten Shield is E. Level chart disagreed on all seven rows: full sides were 'Skill' throughout while content win[] and packet.levelChart agreed on Annie x5 / Akali x2 — proposed the full side flips as one group with matching ratings and whys. Akali was 'he' in six fields. Packet defect 'never names any of Akali's abilities' is now addressed — all five names appear. breakdown.wave and dontsFull[1].d remain templated; the wave text is generic to every assassin and I had nothing Akali-specific to put in it inside the length band.
